items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: in the situation of the lemma there is a canonical isomorphism L_{X/Lambda} = Lpi_!(Li^*Omega_{O/Lambda}) = Lpi_!(i^*Omega_{O/Lambda}) = Lpi_!(Omega_{O/Lambda} tensor O_X) in D(O_X) (source lines 4705-4716). The proof first notes that the value of the sheaf O on any object of the category C_{X/Lambda} is a polynomial algebra over Lambda, so that Omega_{O/Lambda} is flat and the second and third equalities hold; then it uses the remark computing Lpi_! as the sheafification of an explicit complex of presheaves whose value on U is the ring-level complex L_{O_X(U)/Lambda}, and identifies it with the cotangent complex of the ring map Lambda -> O_X on X_etale via the section-level remark and the space-over-ring lemma.
